reasons: United States v. Van Leeuwen is a verified SCOTUS record with citation 397 U.S. 249.

Lake treatment marks it good_law as of 2026-06-30, with varies_by_point=false and no point_overrides.

reviewed.suggested_tightening: Normalize Soldal citation display metadata in the lake record.

reasons: United States v. Place is a verified SCOTUS record with citation 462 U.S. 696.
Lake treatment marks it good_law as of 2026-06-30, with varies_by_point=false and no point_overrides.
The scope note preserves Place while noting later development by Sharpe and Rodriguez, not overruling.
residual_risks: Broad duration language could imply a rigid time limit; the lake scope note says Sharpe developed the duration holding with no rigid time limit.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: When using Place as a general duration rule, add the Sharpe/Rodriguez caveat: no rigid time limit, but no unjustified prolongation.
